_doc: The production broker's settings (z-sdlc process/factory-broker.md). Setup installs this file twice, from one blob: in the tier's library, where the broker reads it and the operations digest covers it (a change here means re-running setup, or every gate is refused), and as /etc/<tier>/config.json, where other tiers on the host find this one. The paths are the first tier's on a host (factory-prod); a later tier uses its own (factory-prod-<instance>), as the enable runbook says. release_branch is factory.json's release.branch; add environment only when factory.json's environments.production isn't factory-production (setup refuses either when it differs). host is the host module's own block: the broker never reads it.
